title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Android detectors that read the code they judge
summary: Lifecycle warnings on ViewBinding and lifecycle-aware observers are gone and the quick fix compiles; Room sees entities with indices and reads coverage per table; Screen Flow draws the edges that start inside a screen; implementation counts skip homonyms; a raw resource named in a URI is not dead.

highlights.title: Lifecycle pairing that knows Android
highlights.description: `Binding.bind(view)`, `lifecycle.addObserver(x)` and `addCallback(viewLifecycleOwner)` release themselves. Resources are read from the right argument or the receiver, mirrors are matched within the class, and the generated `onStop()` calls `super`, uses the receiver and lands inside a one-line mirror.

highlights.title: Room drift on every entity
highlights.description: `@Entity(tableName = …, indices = […])` and an annotation between `@Entity` and `class` hid the entity; `AutoMigration(…, spec = …)` looked like a hole. Coverage is read per table, `CREATE TABLE` migrations count, the property is underlined, and the provider stays silent on a truncated corpus.

highlights.title: Screen Flow and implementation counts
highlights.description: A `navigate("detail/42")` inside a screen reaches the declared detail route instead of leaving it an orphan, `object Home : Screen("home")` resolves its route, and `⬇ N implementations` counts direct overrides of the right parent only.

sections.heading: Lifecycle and Room
bullets: Resource read from the right argument; any identifier argument or the receiver pairs with the release; mirrors matched within the class.
Quick fix: `super.onX()` first, receiver kept, one-line mirror handled, expression body skipped.
Entities with `indices` or an extra annotation are seen; `AutoMigration(spec = …)` parsed; coverage per table; `CREATE TABLE` counts.

sections.heading: Navigation, implementations, resources
bullets: Screen Flow draws `navigate()` calls made inside screens and matches literals to route patterns.
Implementation counts take direct overrides of the parent resolved through imports.
A raw resource named in an `android.resource://` URI is referenced.
